Re-measured: baseline is test/fe-banner-fix at f2ba5450, candidate is this fix at b9d690bd. Improvements show as negative changes.
### Downstream report

#### Frontend

**Frontend (server build, 3 journeys, Node 20.20.2, base f2ba5450, head b9d690bd):** regressions 0, improved 9, withheld 0.

| Journey | Check | Verdict | Detail |
|---|---|---|---|
| home_shows_header | missing assets | improved | /static/promo-banner.png (404) |
| home_shows_header | accessibility | improved | image-alt at img |
| home_shows_header | markup validity | improved | wcag/h37 at html > body > header > img |
| explore_shows_header | missing assets | improved | /static/promo-banner.png (404) |
| explore_shows_header | accessibility | improved | image-alt at img |
| explore_shows_header | markup validity | improved | wcag/h37 at html > body > header > img |
| repo_page_shows_header | missing assets | improved | /static/promo-banner.png (404) |
| repo_page_shows_header | accessibility | improved | image-alt at img |
| repo_page_shows_header | markup validity | improved | wcag/h37 at html > body > header > img |

Base against base: every page check gave the same result twice, so the changes above are not noise.

Frontend files changed: `internal/web/templates/layout.html`.

Not checked: color-contrast, visual layout, real paint/CPU timing. Pages are rendered in happy-dom, which runs the app's JavaScript but has no layout or paint.
